captions.fingertip_figure: Original and restored-seed native-relative fingertip errors on all six saved HUG development cases. Each original bar is the existing mapping error used as that fingertip's cap; it is not an exact native mesh representation. All 30 selected errors are no larger than their original caps by the declared computed norm comparison; the separate 10 mm guard applies to the mean over five tips. Mug B changes by approximately 1 nm per tip and therefore appears unchanged at the millimetre axis scale. Constraint passage is distinct from scientific surface/contact fidelity.
captions.objective_figure: Per-case percentage reduction relative to the original frozen objective, retaining all six cases and the 1.52% Mug B change. Weights, native-relative targets and invalid direction penalties remain fixed. A fitting score is neither a physical success probability nor a mapping acceptance criterion.
